senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נָתַן) [donated, dedicated to the Temple service,] Nathin, a descendant of the Gibeonites (Josh. IX, 27).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:1">Macc. III, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="N01376"><he>נְתִינִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="N01376"><he>נְתִינִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 78b:13">Yeb. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ דוד גזר עליהן</he> as to N’thinim, David decreed concerning them (their exclusion from the Israelitish community with regard to intermarriages).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:3">Ib. VIII, 3</cite> <he>ממזרין ונ׳ אסורין</he> bastards and N’thinim are forbidden (for intermarriage).
Tosef. Kidd. V, 4; a. fr.—Fem. נְתִינָה. Macc. l. c.; a. e.
